_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN): rows 34-L-flow, 34-L-F11, 34-L-brief-off, and the scenario half of 34-L-harness. No model call; the opener is a scripted new_chat_only npc_reply. The runner switches display.playerSetup and display.briefing off for every run (briefingHarness suppressDisplay), so the import first measures the harness default (34-L-harness: setup off auto-Skips and still locks, opener once), then display.playerSetup goes on with display.briefing still off and the story carrying a briefing (34-L-brief-off: the identity pane shows without the briefing sections and still locks). Each of keep / pick / create / skip (34-L-flow) runs after clearing the chat, unlocking it (server copy read back) and a Restart: the pane is offered, no opener before the choice, then chat_metadata.persona on the SERVER copy (/api/chats/group/get) is the expected avatar, the record is locked, and exactly one opener is in the chat and on the server. Pick chooses SO-V2734 Tamsin, whose description lacks the role, and a dry run (GENERATE_AFTER_COMBINE_PROMPTS / CHAT_COMPLETION_PROMPT_READY, no model) must carry 'SO-V2734 Tamsin is a lantern-bearer for hire' (34-L-F11). The pane is driven through its DOM (#so-player-setup, [data-so=player-setup-keep|pick|create], #so-player-setup-pick, #so-briefing-start), the same controls so-ui.mts player-setup-choose clicks, because the scenario ui vocabulary has no player-setup action. Setup makes two marker personas with /persona-create and pins power_user.persona_auto_lock off so ST never locks on its own; cleanup restores the selected persona and auto-lock and removes every SO-V2734 persona (so-assets marker, which also matches the 'Story: SO-V2734 Player Setup' title). The rest of 34-L-harness (so-assets list, so-run-header inventory.personas) is CLI, not scenario. Open: S30-1 (a persona switch on a fresh group chat runs reloadCurrentChat, personas.js retriggerFirstMessageOnEmptyChat) may lapse the pick/create choice; a red there is that question answered. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-34-player-setup.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" on a no-model dev lane.

requires.why: scripted opener and /sendas only; the persona writes need a lane, never the real install
